title: SANTA wire-tier actuals
description: A runner's output for one wire vector: an object mapping each entry's name to { bytes_hex, error }. Success: the runner's reserialization (lower-case hex) + error null. Otherwise bytes_hex null + an outcome tag. A single round-trip verdict; no cost dimension. Companion to docs/specs/wire-tier.md.

error.description: null = round-tripped to bytes; 'errored' = parse/reserialize threw (the codec's message in 'reason'); 'not-implemented' = no serializer for this kind; 'panicked' = an uncaught internal error, caught so the run continues (always coal, message in 'note'). A serializer's own failure on a value is errored/panicked — never a separate 'excuse' tag the harness authors on its behalf.

reason.description: Rejecting/erroring impl's reason string (e.g. the codec's message on 'errored'). Diagnostic only — not graded.

note.description: Panic message/class. Present iff error == 'panicked'; forbidden otherwise.

allOf.$comment: error null => bytes_hex non-null (the reserialization); any non-null tag => bytes_hex null.
note present iff error is 'panicked'; forbidden otherwise.
